register.description: Register to control pin configuration and muxing

bitfield.description: Lock 0 - Padconfig register is unlocked 1 - Padconfig register is locked from further writes Reset Source: mod_por_rst_n
Wakeup event status 0 - No wake event on pin 1 - Wake event occurred on pin Reset Source: mod_por_rst_n
Wakeup enable 0 - Wakeup operation disabled 1 - Wakeup operation enabled Reset Source: mod_por_rst_n
Deep Sleep pull-up/down selection 0 - Offmode pulldown selected 1 - Offmode pullup selected Reset Source: mod_por_rst_n
Deep Sleep pull-up/down enable (active low) 0 - Pullup / pulldown is enabled 1 - Pullup / pulldown is disabled Reset Source: mod_por_rst_n
Deep Sleep output value 0 - Output value is 0 1 - Output value is 1 Reset Source: mod_por_rst_n
Deep Sleep output disable 0 - Output enabled 1 - Output disabled Reset Source: mod_por_rst_n
Deep Sleep override control 0 - IO keeps its previous state when Deep Sleep mode is active 1 - IO state is forced to OFF mode value when Deep Sleep mode is active Reset Source: mod_por_rst_n
Isolation Bypass0 - IO isolation is preserved1 - IO isolation is bypassed Reset Source: mod_por_rst_n
Isolation Override0 - IO isolation is preserved1 - IO isolation is overridden Reset Source: mod_por_rst_n
Driver Disable0 - Driver is enabled1 - Driver is disabled Reset Source: mod_por_rst_n
Drive Strength Control for dual volatge IOs. Selects the drive strength value for LVCMOS pins. For 1.8V only IO, bitundefined maps to Slew Control pin. Reset Source: mod_por_rst_n
Input enable for the Pad0 - Receiver disabled1 - Receiver enabled Reset Source: mod_por_rst_n
Pad Pullup / Pulldown type selection0 - Pulldown selected1 - Pullup selected Reset Source: mod_por_rst_n
Pad Pullup / Pulldown enable. This is an active low signal.0 - Pullup / Pulldown enabled1 - Pullup / Pulldown disabled Reset Source: mod_por_rst_n

Enable pad Deep Sleep controls by overriding WKUP DM gating0 - Deep Sleep pad controls are gated by the WKUP DM1 - Activate Deep Sleep pad controls (override WKUP DM gating logic) Reset Source: mod_por_rst_n
Receiver Schmitt Trigger enable 0 - Schmitt trigger input disabled 1 - Schmitt trigger input enabled Reset Source: mod_por_rst_n
Selects the debouce period for the pad. Reset Source: mod_por_rst_n

Level Sensitive Wakeup PolarityThis bit is not relevant unless wk_lvl_en is set to 1'b1.0 - Low. A low (0) value on the pin causes a wakeup1 - High. A high (1) value on the pin causes a wakeup Reset Source: mod_por_rst_n

Level Sensitive Wakeup Enable0 - Disabled. Wakeup is triggered by change of the pin input value1 - Enabled. Wakeup is triggered when the pin matches the value specified by wk_lvl_pol. The chosen polarity must be maintained. (e.g. until wakeup completion is confirmed) Reset Source: mod_por_rst_n

Virtual MAIN_GPIO instance select.These bits select which instance of GPIO is used for this I/O pad. This allows protection between two different Processor virtual worlds. These bits have no effect if GPIO mode (muxmode=7) is not selected for the PAD. Refer Pinmux to identify if a pin supports virtual GPIO function or not.Field values (others are reserved):2'b00 - Implement GPIO in GPIO_0 instance2'b01 - Implement GPIO in GPIO_2 instance Reset Source: mod_por_rst_n
